public_disposition: Already overlaps the public results, validation, research journey, and method catalog; no independent experiment result is counted.
Post-hoc OOF analysis described weak early-prefix ranking. The report explicitly recommends against tuning or promoting a model from this diagnostic.
A fixed history-only ACF descriptor passed five of six frozen checks but failed the predeclared requirement for gains in both ACF-tail regimes; the recipe was closed.

report_title: Clean V2 with OSN-RFF and full-scan U direct-head screen
public_disposition: Four causal X-only features were compared with the fixed 15-feature Clean V2 head on the same five folds. The candidate favored the exposed CV-A comparison and the one-shot reduced diagnostic, but neither was independent confirmation.

report_title: Direct-head runtime and artifact feasibility audit
public_disposition: Runtime, artifact, and parity checks concern the same post-selection direct-head screen as RPT-004. Extrapolated head latency is not end-to-end or hosted-runtime evidence.
Replacing zero-split feature inputs with zero preserved sampled predictions, but the audit still computed the original feature state and did not establish a runtime gain.
Two drop-in convolution alternatives were slower on the tested single-window shapes and did not preserve exact arithmetic at every layer; neither was promoted.
Only three of four planned end-to-end timing passes completed; counters were not retained, so the report does not establish a general speedup.
The audit identified overwritten intermediate calculations and exact predictions on sampled streams. Earlier timing differences were small and inconsistent; no promoted speed claim was made.
Local array-backed pilots were faster with bitwise-equal outputs, but they did not use the guarded streaming contract and do not establish hosted-runtime benefit.
A narrow scalar fast path was measured on local training samples only. The report does not establish full-population or hosted inference performance.
The tested multi-thread inference path regressed against serial execution on its sample and was rejected.

The offline calibration used each stream’s final online length, information unavailable to an unsized live iterator. A fixed-length fallback changed the null distribution; this is future-length leakage, not label leakage.

The exact-start maximum and a normalized Bayesian mixture were near chance alone; each fixed small blend reduced the exact reference-package score on both screened folds. Prefix mutation passed, but the transfer screen was partial and the recipe was stopped.
The fixed-g mixtures trailed the maximum-GLR control; the fixed blend was effectively tied. The screen used all five grouped CV-A folds but remained post-selection.
The fixed OOF analysis found fold-specific gaps across history-regime groups. It was descriptive and did not fit or tune a model.
The audit corrected the interpretation of history-ACF groups: the runner used 20/60/20 percentile bands rather than equal terciles. Its decile extension was exploratory and post-selection.

The classifier learned the transformation task, but break ranking was near chance and fixed blends lowered the reference score across held seeds; the recipe was closed before competition-fold evaluation.
The nine-expert candidate lost to the Gaussian AR bank on all four seed rotations, with the primary predeclared advancement gate failing. No challenge folds were accessed.
The stage-two selection objective used two folds. Full five-fold replay placed all reported alternatives below the previous trial-13 reference, so the selected stage-two candidates were not promoted.
